seo.title: 7,000-year-old leather links ancient dna to modern Asturian goat
seo.description:
A 7,000-year-old leather fragment discovered in Cueva de los Murciélagos, Spain, contains ancient DNA. Genetic testing shows the DNA matches the modern Bermeya goat that lives in Asturias, illustrating a 7,000-year genetic link.

#ancientdna #bermeyagoat #archaeology #spainhistory

Sources:
- https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371%2Fjournal.pone.0358468
- https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/1149590
- https://portalcomunicacion.uah.es/diario-digital/actualidad/La-UAH-participa-en-una-investigacion-que-demuestra-que-una-piel-de-cabra-de-hace-7.000-anos-revela-una-conexion-genetica-con-la-actual-raza-Bermeya
